1: The Lord comes down, and the mountains melt. Samaria and Jerusalem are the centres of the sin.
2: Woe to those who lie awake planning to seize fields and houses.
God will gather a remnant like sheep.
3: Rulers tear the skin off the people, prophets preach for pay, priests teach for a price. Zion will be ploughed like a field.
4: In days to come nations will stream to Zion, and each will sit under his own vine, unafraid.
5: "You, Bethlehem, too little to be among the clans of Judah, from you shall come a ruler in Israel."
The scribes quote this to Herod when the Magi ask where the Christ is to be born.
6: God pleads his case: what have I done to you? Not thousands of rams, but "to do justice, to love kindness, and to walk humbly with your God".
The Good Friday Reproaches echo this. One verse sums up true religion.
7: Who is a God like you?
The godly have vanished, but "when I fall, I shall rise". God delights in mercy and will cast our sins into the depths of the sea.
Sins forgiven are gone for good.
